caption: The drawing depicts a tall, rectangular wooden clock with ornate carvings and detailed decorations. The clock face is square, situated in the upper third of the clock, and features black Arabic numerals from 1 to 12 on a cream background with black clock hands pointing at approximately 10:47. Surrounding the clock face are carved wooden borders, and the top of the clock has an elaborate decorative crest with a curved motif. Below the clock face, there are two light gold vertical columns flanking a glass or mirrored panel in the middle section. The bottom section contains a rectangular panel with a black background and painted floral patterns in pink, red, green, and white. The main wooden frame is colored in rich brown tones with carved detailing on the vertical sides and corners, and the entire clock sits on four short, carved legs. The artist’s signature is visible in the bottom right corner of the image. The background of the drawing is a plain beige color.
title: Shelf Clock
